sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mac Moincanta was an Irish god, a minor divinity of the Tuatha Dé Danann. He was called father of the gods after the beneficent Dagda gave up that title. Later he was named a fairy king. The more important Fionnbharr then unseated him as the head of the Irish fairies.
